steps.name: The organisation's own grievance cell
steps.when_to_use: First. Complain in writing and keep the complaint / docket number.

steps.name: Centralized Public Grievances Redressal and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS)
steps.when_to_use: If there is a grievance regarding non-receipt of PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana benefits under a central government scheme / central ministry

note: You can register, track status, and check your PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana eligibility via the official portal (pmvbry.epfindia.gov.in or pmvbry.labour.gov.in) or through the UMANG app using Face Authentication Technology (FAT) for UAN generation. If your scheme benefit remains uncredited after employer continuous 6-month ECR compliance, you may lodge a public grievance on CPGRAMS.
